## Column One

Three-column mode divides the page into three equal sections. Each column is narrow, so concise content works best.

**Good uses:**
- Short reading lists
- Brief notes sections
- Side-by-side comparisons

**Writing space:**

## Column Two

Keep content compact. Long paragraphs will feel cramped in narrow columns — use short sentences and bullet points.
